title: SQL Server logs no update that changes nothing
symptom: An UPDATE setting a row to its own values: the audit trigger fired, but no CDC row and no Debezium event
cause: SQL Server writes no log record when no byte of the row changes, and CDC reads the log
effect: No data is lost, but event counts and trigger-based audits don't match the change log
fix: Compare rows, not event counts; the test's updates always set a new value
